title: 5.2L Ignition: System and Component References
introduction:
For Engine Ignition - 5.2L 32V Ti-VCT, this page points to the required system and component reading. I keep that engine label beside the reference: “Mustang ignition” is a wider shelf than this particular entry covers.

Read the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual at the location below for the actual explanations. This page contains no ignition operating details, component descriptions, diagnostic tests or repair steps.
